pairs.question: Which roller coaster is faster?
pairs.fact: Formula Rossa in Abu Dhabi launches riders to 149 mph in under 5 seconds.

pairs.question: Which element was discovered first?
pairs.fact: Hennig Brand discovered phosphorus in 1669 while boiling down urine, looking for gold.

pairs.question: Gram for gram, which has less sugar?
pairs.fact: Gram for gram, a mango has more sugar than a banana, and grapes beat both.

pairs.question: Which LEGO set has more pieces?
pairs.fact: The 2022 LEGO Eiffel Tower has 10,001 pieces and stands almost 5 feet tall.

pairs.question: Which movie won more Oscars?
pairs.fact: Three films share the record of 11 Oscars: Ben-Hur, Titanic and The Return of the King.

pairs.question: Who scored more career NBA points?
pairs.fact: LeBron James became the first player to pass 40,000 regular-season points in 2024.

pairs.question: Which college has more undergraduates?
pairs.fact: Texas A&M has more undergraduates than any other US campus, over 50,000.

pairs.question: Which national park is bigger?
pairs.fact: Wrangell–St. Elias, the biggest US national park, is larger than Switzerland.

pairs.question: Which Broadway show ran for more performances?
pairs.fact: The Phantom of the Opera played 13,981 performances over 35 years, the longest run in Broadway history.

pairs.question: Which city gets more snow each year?
pairs.fact: Syracuse, New York averages over 120 inches of snow a year, more than any other big US city.
